title: Traditional British Baked Date Cake
description: A moist and flavorful cake made with dates and a hint of spice, perfect for a warm evening.
instructions: Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the dates, British dish, and Welsh butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the date mixture and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
